articles.title: Earth's Building Blocks Came From Its Own Neighborhood, Study Finds
articles.summary: A new study says Earth formed entirely from inner Solar System material — not from beyond Jupiter as many thought. Researchers were 'truly astonished.' The finding changes how we explain Earth's water.

articles.title: National Zoo Celebrates Three New Red Panda Cubs
articles.summary: Three endangered red panda cubs were born this summer at the Smithsonian's National Zoo. One is 'feisty' and huff-quacks at keepers. Fewer than 10,000 red pandas remain in the wild.

articles.title: Orcas Turn Sunfish Into Piñatas, Scientists Discover
articles.summary: New footage shows orcas slamming into sunfish hard enough to make them explode. One orca holds the fish while another smashes it. Scientists think it may feed young orcas — or just be fun.
